headline: Base Ownership Swings on Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the balance has shifted sharply on two unsettled fronts. Linn Mercy now reports ten Colonial bases, no Warden bases and one unheld, reversing the prior tally of eight Colonial and two Warden holdings with one unheld. In Weathered Expanse, Colonial holdings have climbed from three to five as Warden holdings fell from three to one; three bases remain unheld. Marban Hollow is unchanged at four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld, while Mooring County remains eleven Warden and one unheld. The latest ledgers show Weathered still in motion, with nine event rows in two hours, against three in Mooring and one in Linn; loss and capture rows may describe the same transfer. Marban and Nevish Line have recorded no events in the past two hours, despite 30 and 31 event rows respectively over 24 hours. Heavy casualty totals persist in Weathered, Linn and Nevish. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
